{"decision":"RECORDED AS BRAINSTORMING, NOT AS A PROPOSAL. Anthony, 2026-09-16, in his words: "being able to do something like /log-issue. Sometimes in active development of a project, just need to be able to capture an issue that occurred and can come back to it later. Sometimes they are also things that aren't necessarily things that have /root-cause. I don't know if this should be generalized to /capture-something (may not be an issue or brainstorm, etc). Usually these are things that you'd like to follow up on later."

⭐ WHAT HE IS ASKING FOR IS A MOMENT, NOT A NODE TYPE. The record already has the durable forms (below); what it lacks is a capture that costs one word while the person is focused on something else. That is the same finding two earlier ideas reached from two directions — a to-do with no cheap home (2026-08-25) and a failure never revisited mid-task (2026-09-12) — and this is the third arrival, which makes it a class.

═══ WHAT THE GRAPH ALREADY HOLDS ═══
· rule:an-identified-issue-is-enduring-never-dropped (his word, 2026-08-20): an identified issue becomes a durable node, an asked Question with a name, or a computed finding — never only a sentence in a conversation. The rule exists; the cheap door does not.
· record_finding: a dated observation on the node it concerns, one call, and it demands root-cause only when the text is a CAUSE — an issue with no cause offered is already legal there. It requires a subject_id that resolves, which is the one thing a person mid-task may not have to hand.
· report_manual_work: hand-rolled work with a closed diagnosis. Right form for one shape of issue, wrong for most.
· The brainstorm skill: one Decision at proposed. Right for an idea, wrong for "the export timed out, look later".
· plan-increments: claims the to-do ground and is a delivery ritual (the 2026-08-25 idea's finding).
· req:detecting-is-not-asking: record unconditionally at the moment, invite attention at a boundary. This is the shape any answer here must take, or it becomes a nag.

═══ THE OPTIONS, none chosen ═══
A. /log-issue, DELIBERATELY TINY. One skill, two lines: record_finding with fact_type `follow_up`, subject defaulting to the Project when nothing nearer is named, the person's sentence as the statement, dated. No diagnosis, no cause, no node-type question. Surfaced at boundaries (capture-session, an increment close, loop_status) as "N follow-ups never revisited". ⚠️ Cost: a 24th skill on a set already hard to keep coherent; and a default subject of the Project is a node that will collect everything, so the boundary read must list them or they are a drawer.
B. /capture-something, GENERALISED — one door, one question ("issue, idea, or to-do?"), then routed: issue -> A; idea -> brainstorm; to-do -> the planned Verification / Capability / Artifact the task idea's option C describes. ⚠️ Cost, and it is the serious one: the routing question IS the ceremony he is trying to avoid — asking "which kind is this?" at the moment of capture is the translation step the 2026-08-25 idea already found too expensive. A general door that asks is worse than three specific doors that do not.
C. ROUTE AT THE BOUNDARY, NOT AT CAPTURE. Capture everything as A (a dated follow-up on the nearest node or the Project), and let the boundary read do the sorting: when capture-session or an increment close lists the follow-ups, THAT is when each becomes a finding, a brainstorm, a planned check, or is dropped with a word. ⭐ Cheapest at the moment that matters, and it is exactly req:detecting-is-not-asking. ⚠️ Cost: a follow-up that is never dispositioned is a to-do list by another name — the tracker objection that killed the Task node type applies unless the boundary read is real and the disposition is one word.
D. NO NEW SKILL — the tools exist; teach the agent to call record_finding mid-task. ⚠️ Cost: measured not to work. The rule from 2026-09-06 asks for exactly this and three failures in that session went unrecorded until he asked; the failure-mid-task idea's whole premise is that "the agent will remember" is the unreliable leg. A slash command is an affordance, not a reminder.
E. LET THE SERVER DO IT for the failures it can see (the refusal ledger, option A of the failure-mid-task idea), and reserve the human capture for what the server cannot see — a shell error, a thought, a colleague's remark. ⚠️ Cost: two mechanisms; but they cover different populations and the split is honest.

═══ THE TEST THAT WOULD DECIDE IT ═══
Write A as a two-line skill and use it for one real week on his work project. Count how many follow-ups it captures, how many the boundary read surfaces, and how many get a disposition. If the third number is near zero, C's tracker objection is confirmed and the capture is a drawer; if it is most of them, A+C is the answer and B was never needed.
